source.document: BMW Commissioning of the Sensors for the Driver Assistance Systems (Service Pack 2021, dated 6/25/2024)
source.note: Equipment depends on vehicle option code (SA5xx series). Verify equipment before calibrating. If commissioning is necessary after repairs, observe the relevant information in the repair instructions.

general_requirements: BMW uses 'commissioning' to describe the calibration/initialization procedure. Commissioning requirements depend on the specific sensor and whether the action is renewal (replacement), removal/installation or swap, or programming/coding. Several sensors also require commissioning after specific body repairs near the sensor.

components.calibration_note: Yes: commissioning required after renewal. Yes: commissioning required after removal/installation or swap. No: commissioning NOT required after programming/coding. Alignment via adjustment screw: depending on derivative.
components.trigger_lead: Commissioning required when any of the following apply:
triggers: Sensor is renewed (replaced)
Sensor is removed, installed, or swapped
Body repairs in the area of the radar sensor (e.g., renewing the radome, renewing the holder)

components.component: FRSF - Front Radar Sensor Long Range
components.calibration_note: Yes: commissioning required after renewal. Yes: commissioning required after removal/installation or swap. No: commissioning NOT required after programming/coding. Alignment via adjustment screw: depending on derivative.
components.trigger_lead: Commissioning required when any of the following apply:
triggers: Sensor is renewed (replaced)
Sensor is removed, installed, or swapped
Body repairs in the area of the radar sensor (e.g., renewing the radome, renewing the holder)

components.component: HRSNL / HRSNR - Rear Radar Sensors Near Range (Left and Right)
components.location: Rear bumper area, left and right
components.calibration_note: Yes: commissioning required after renewal. Yes: commissioning required after removal/installation or swap. No: commissioning NOT required after programming/coding. Alignment via adjustment screw: No. Comply with the regulations for repainting.
components.trigger_lead: Commissioning required when any of the following apply:
triggers: Sensor is renewed (replaced)
Sensor is removed, installed, or swapped
Defined body repairs in the area of the sensor (e.g., renewing the bumper, renewing the holder)

components.component: SRSNVL / SRSNVR - Side Radar Sensor Short Range Front (Left and Right)
components.calibration_note: Yes: commissioning required after renewal. Yes: commissioning required after removal/installation or swap. No: commissioning NOT required after programming/coding. Alignment via adjustment screw: No. Comply with the regulations for repainting.
components.trigger_lead: Commissioning required when any of the following apply:
triggers: Sensor is renewed (replaced)
Sensor is removed, installed, or swapped
Body repairs in the area of the sensor (e.g., bumper disassembly)

components.component: SRSNML / SRSNMR - Center Close-Range Side Radar Sensor (Left and Right)
components.calibration_note: No: commissioning NOT required after renewal. Yes* (see below): required after removal/installation or swap. No: not required after programming/coding. No static or dynamic commissioning is required. If the fault 'Changed installation position detected' is stored, the correction angles in the radar sensor must be reset. If the fault 'Misalignment' is stored, the correction angles must be reset after the repair work. Use the service function.
components.trigger_lead: Reset correction angles via service function only when any of the following faults are stored:
triggers: Fault 'Changed installation position detected' is stored (reset correction angles)
Fault 'Misalignment' is stored (reset correction angles after repair work)

components.component: ADCAML / ADCAMM - Autonomous Driving Camera (Low / Mid)
components.calibration_note: No: commissioning NOT required after renewal. Yes* (see below): required after removal/installation or swap. Calibration values must be reset as part of replacing the windshield or removing/installing the same sensor, or after a swap. Use the service function.
components.trigger_lead: Calibration values must be reset (via service function) when any of the following apply:
triggers: Replacing the windshield
Removing or installing the same sensor
Sensor swap

components.component: Augmented Reality Camera (connected to HU-H Headunit High)
components.calibration_note: No: commissioning NOT required after renewal. Yes* (see below): required after removal/installation or swap. Calibration values must be reset as part of replacing the windshield or removing/installing the same sensor, or after a swap. Use the service function.
components.trigger_lead: Calibration values must be reset (via service function) when any of the following apply:
triggers: Replacing the windshield
Removing or installing the same sensor
Sensor swap

components.component: Lidar Sensor (LIDARVM - Lidar Control Unit, Front Center)
components.calibration_note: No: commissioning NOT required after renewal. Yes* (see below): required after removal/installation or swap. No static or dynamic commissioning is required. If the fault 'Misalignment' is stored, the correction angles must be reset after the repair work. Use the service function.
components.trigger_lead: Reset correction angles via service function only when any of the following faults are stored:
triggers: Fault 'Misalignment' is stored (reset correction angles after repair work)

not_requiring_commissioning: Front, Rear, Left, and Right Autonomous Parking Cameras (SA5DN, connected to UCAP)
Gesture Recognition Camera (SA6U7, integrated into FZD Roof Function Center)
Interior Camera (SA4NR, integrated into FZD Roof Function Center)
Driver Camera System (SA6U3, integrated into Display Cluster)
Ultrasonic Sensors (front, side front, rear, side rear — SA5DM/SA5DN/SA5DW, connected to UCAP/USS)
